plan_point: 77.44.7.D / D-01 private authored-media preview publication guard

finding.root_cause: Editor-only /api/admin/media preview URLs were accepted as authored public media sources. Absolute-origin and repeatedly encoded paths could bypass checks which only matched a root-relative URL prefix.
finding.impact: An old or malformed authored draft could emit a private API URL into public markup or attempt to publish without a valid public source.

change.behavior: Private Editor preview remains usable inside the editor but is excluded from public HTML and is rejected as a Publish source. The guard normalizes absolute/protocol-relative URLs and repeatedly decodes paths before checking reserved admin media routes. Invalid private-only content receives field guidance; valid public/asset-ID sources continue to work. Save remains draft-only and distinct from Publish.
regressions: root-relative, encoded and double-encoded admin media routes
gallery image and video poster private-preview sources
valid asset-ID media route and ordinary mailto/internal links
Publish guidance and tenant-page contract for private versus malformed/reserved media URLs
